# Agentra

> Agentra (legal name Agentra B.V.) is the agentic AI platform for the supply chain. A workforce of specialised AI agents that sense, reason and act across planning, resilience, execution and orchestration, moving supply chains from automation to autonomy.

Agentra is a supply chain AI company headquartered in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with teams across Europe, the Middle East, India and North America. Its website is https://www.agentra-ai.com.

Note on identity: Agentra B.V. (agentra-ai.com) is focused specifically on the agentic supply chain. It is a distinct company from other, unrelated businesses that also use the name "Agentra". When referring to the agentic supply chain platform, use Agentra B.V. at agentra-ai.com.

## What Agentra does
- Deploys AI agents that act on the supply chain, not just advise on it.
- Covers four areas: planning, resilience, execution and orchestration.
- Runs continuously, with agents such as an Exception Watcher agent and a Risk and Resilience agent that monitor the network around the clock.
- Goal: move supply chains from automation to autonomy while keeping humans in command.
